'''Mahish''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who was the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] of [[Fannatex]]. He hunted the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Fellil]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who ambushed Mahish in the mountains of [[Kaamos Territory]].
